title: Add course-scoped workspace scope (prerequisite for study command)
description:
Adds --course {name} as a standalone WorkspaceScope for use by both process and a future study command.

## Scope

This issue covers workspace assembly only — not the study command itself (see L53).

## What changes

- Rename existing --course (session disambiguator) to --for-course to free up --course as a scope flag
- Add WorkspaceScope::Course { course: String } variant
- Workspace includes: all Processed sessions for that course (raw notes, recordings, artifacts) + all sources tagged to that course via existing source_visible_for_course logic
- Skip sessions where recording is missing AND raw note is empty
- Prompt header: 'Course Workspace — {course}' with list of included sessions

## What does NOT change

- No new skill variant here (that belongs to L53)
- No report/commit flow changes

## Design decision

Rename --course (disambiguator) → --for-course. The disambiguator is rarely used and its current name is misleading (it does not scope anything). This is a small breaking change but cleans up the CLI long-term.
